title: Three Layers as Enforcement
description: Layers separate permissions by path glob, not by naming.
body: The three layers are not organisational tidiness. They are the enforcement mechanism for the rule that an agent shall not change the design: the permission boundary is a path glob, so CODEOWNERS and a CI path check enforce it mechanically rather than by instruction. A benchmark job appending latency numbers writes to `runs/`; a person editing a contract writes to `nodes/`; the two writes never conflict.
